mcpCode: S = load('input.mat'); disp(fieldnames(S)); A=S.A; x=S.x; b=S.b; claims=S.claims; disp(size(A)); disp(size(x)); disp(size(b)); disp(class(claims)); disp(claims);
format long g; disp('A'); disp(A); disp('x'); disp(x); disp('b'); disp(b);

addpath('skills/matlab-data-analysis/scripts'); S=load('input.mat'); r = mas_linsolve_check(S.A,S.x,S.b,S.claims); disp(r.verdict); disp(r.checks); fprintf('eta %.6e cond %.6e rank %d bound %.6e routeDiff %.6e\n', r.backwardError, r.cond, r.rank, r.errorBound, r.routeDiff);

addpath('skills/matlab-data-analysis/scripts'); S=load('input.mat'); r=mas_linsolve_check(S.A,S.x,S.b,S.claims); for k=1:numel(r.checks), fprintf('%-13s %-12s %s\n', r.checks(k).id, r.checks(k).status, r.checks(k).detail); end; format long g; res=S.b-S.A*S.x; disp('residual'); disp(res); disp('norms: ||res|| ||A|| ||x|| ||b||'); disp([norm(res) norm(S.A,2) norm(S.x,2) norm(S.b,2)]); xt=S.A\S.b; disp('xtrue = A\b'); disp(xt); disp('x - xtrue'); disp(S.x-xt); disp('relative forward error'); disp(norm(S.x-xt)/norm(xt)); disp('exact solve via 1/33 factors?'); disp(xt*33);

S=load('input.mat'); A=sym(S.A,'f'); ex=symengine('rational'); As=sym(S.A,'r'); bs=sym(S.b,'r'); xs=sym(S.x,'r'); disp('exact A\b (rational)'); xt=As\bs; disp(xt); disp('claimed x as rational (exact double)'); disp(xs'); disp('claimed minus exact'); disp(nsimplify(xs'-xt)); disp('exact residual b-A*x (rational)'); r2=bs-As*xs; disp(r2); disp(double(r2)); disp('required residual norm for tolRel 1e-8'); kappa=cond(double(S.A,2)); etaT=1e-8/kappa; disp([etaT etaT*(norm(S.A,2)*norm(S.x,2)+norm(S.b,2))]); disp('actual / required'); disp(norm(S.b-S.A*S.x)/(etaT*(norm(S.A,2)*norm(S.x,2)+norm(S.b,2))));

S=load('input.mat'); As=sym(S.A,'r'); bs=sym(S.b,'r'); xs=sym(S.x,'r'); xt=As\bs; disp('exact A\b (rational)'); disp(xt'); disp('claimed x (exact rational of doubles)'); disp(xs'); disp('claimed - exact'); disp(nsimplify(xs'-xt)); disp('exact residual b-A*xClaimed'); rr=bs-As*xs; disp(rr'); disp(double(rr')); kappa=cond(S.A,2); disp(['cond(A) ' num2str(kappa)]); req=1e-8/kappa*(norm(S.A,2)*norm(S.x,2)+norm(S.b,2)); disp('required ||res|| for tolRel=1e-8'); disp(req); disp('actual ||res||'); disp(norm(S.b-S.A*S.x)); disp('ratio actual/required'); disp(norm(S.b-S.A*S.x)/req);

S=load('input.mat'); As=sym(S.A,'r'); bs=sym(S.b,'r'); xs=sym(S.x,'r'); xt=As\bs; disp('exact A\b rational as char'); disp(char(xt')); rr=bs-As*xs; disp('exact residual rational as char'); disp(char(rr')); disp('exact residual double'); disp(double(rr')); disp('claimed-exact double'); disp(double((xt-xs)')); disp(vpa(xt',25));

S=load('input.mat'); A=S.A; x=S.x; b=S.b; d=round(det(A)); disp(['det(A) = ' num2str(d)]); Nt=round(44*(A\b))'; disp('Cramer numerators (44*x_exact) = [14 -136 146] expected'); disp(Nt); disp('verify A*(Nt/44) - b == 0 exactly:'); disp(norm(b - A*(Nt/44),'inf')); disp('exact solution x = [7/22; -34/11; 73/22], claimed x minus exact:'); disp(x - Nt'/44); disp('residual b-A*x (should equal A*(exact-claimed)):'); disp(b-A*x'); disp('residual explained purely by the 1e-3 error, not conditioning:'); disp(['cond2(A) = ' num2str(cond(A,2))]); disp(['backward error eta = ' num2str(norm(b-A*x,2)/(norm(A,2)*norm(x,2)+norm(b,2)))]); disp(['10*n*eps = ' num2str(10*3*eps)]); disp(['forward error vs exact = ' num2str(norm(x-Nt'/44,2)/norm(Nt'/44,2))]); disp(['tolRel claim = ' num2str(S.claims.tolRel)]); disp(['attainable floor kappa*eps = ' num2str(cond(A,2)*eps)]);

S=load('input.mat'); A=S.A; x=S.x; b=S.b; xe = [14;-136;146]/44; disp('A*xe - b (exact integer arithmetic check)'); disp(A*xe - b); disp('claimed x - exact x'); disp(x - xe); disp('b - A*x'); disp(b - A*x); disp('norms and errors'); nA=norm(A,2); nx=norm(x,2); nb=norm(b,2); eta=norm(b-A*x,2)/(nA*nx+nb); k=cond(A,2); fprintf('||res||=%.6e  eta=%.6e  10n*eps=%.6e
', norm(b-A*x,2), eta, 30*eps); fprintf('cond2(A)=%.6f  kappa*eta=%.6e  kappa*eps=%.6e  tolRel=%.1e
', k, k*eta, k*eps, S.claims.tolRel); fprintf('forward err vs exact = %.6e
', norm(x-xe,2)/norm(xe,2)); fprintf('required ||res|| for tolRel = %.6e
', S.claims.tolRel/k*(nA*nx+nb));

t = fileread('result.json'); j = jsondecode(t); disp('json ok, verdict = '+j.verdict); disp(fieldnames(j)); S2=load('input.mat'); disp('input.mat unchanged vars:'); disp(fieldnames(S2)); disp(S2.claims); disp(datestr(fileattrib('input.mat'))); disp(datestr(fileattrib('result.json')));

', datestr(fileattrib('result.json')), fileattrib('result.json').bytes);

result.notes: 被报告的 x 不满足 Ax=b，残差与条件数都否定该解。证据：(1) 残差 ||b-A*x||_2=4.583e-3，向后误差 eta=8.124e-5，比舍入地板 10*n*eps=6.66e-15 大约 1.2e9 倍，也远大于支撑 tolRel=1e-8 所需的 ||res||<=1.676e-7；mas_linsolve_check 的 residual 检查判 fail。(2) cond(A)=3.366、rank=3、det=44，系统良态且满秩，因此残差不可能由病态条件解释（kappa*eps=7.5e-16 才是本可达到的精度地板）。(3) 用整数 Cramer 法则得到精确解 x_exact=[14;-136;146]/44=[7/22;-34/11;73/22]，验证 A*x_exact-b 在双精度下严格为 0；被报告的 x 与精确解只差在第一分量 +1e-3，相对前向误差 2.200e-4，与误差界 kappa*eta=2.734e-4 一致，比声明的 1e-8 大约 2.2e4 倍。(4) LU 与 QR 两条独立路由的解与被报告 x 差 2.2e-4，超过条件数调整后阈值 1e-9。结论：残差与条件数均不支持『x 是解且达到 1e-8 精度』的声明，判 FAIL。
